svg.title: Virtual Assistant — Welcome — Embedded third-party web
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the observed embedded COMP chatbot webpage, not native PolyULife content. Source: virtual-assistant-154651-disclaimer.png or virtual-assistant-154708-welcome.png. Logo crop (35,192,98,255) and avatar crop (32,334,96,393) from the public Welcome screenshot; no personal data or encoded personal QR. Visible text and browser controls remain native editable objects. Font and vector icons are approximations. No AX-only input field is added.

g.text: As your Virtual Assistant, I'm here to help by providing
responses based on my training. For the most detailed
and up-to-date information, please visit our
. I hope you will enjoy the search
